name: Island Assessment Agent
mandate: Hold the Island Creator Agent to the lore and the GDD for Bracken Isle: no holes, no empty or unreferenced meshes, a collider that matches what the player sees, a quick load, correct lighting in every phase, and a faithful read of the island concept art. Review the plan first, then the finished work, using only the offline AI Crew and deterministic checks.
rubric_focus: Every objective is scored 1-10 with a reason it is not one point higher or lower.
Geometry checks are measured (empty meshes, hole loops, open-edge ratio, degenerate triangles), not asserted.
The island is lit by the Lighting agent's rig, never by baked or per-asset lights that fight it.
Anything that costs FAL credits or decides canon is a creator decision, not an assumption.

must_cover.topic: No empty, hollow or unreferenced meshes and no holes in the island meshes

template.title: Audit island meshes for empty, hollow and unreferenced geometry
template.detail: Run the mesh audit over every island mesh in use and repair any finding.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: mesh audit reports zero empty meshes, zero hole loops

template.title: Set and meet an island load-time budget
template.detail: Define the budget, measure it headless in Godot, cut cost until met.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: measured load time within the budget

checks.note: Run the headless load timing script in Godot.

must_cover.topic: Island lit properly by the Lighting agent in every phase

template.title: Verify island lighting in every phase with the Lighting agent
template.detail: Check ISLAND, OUTBOUND, RETURN and BEACON_RELIT.
template.why_score: Named by the creator as a must.
acceptance: island legible in all four phases

checks.note: Capture a screenshot per phase in Godot.

must_cover.topic: Collider matches the visible island (no fall-through, no invisible walls)

template.title: Prove the island collider matches the visual
template.detail: Raycast sweep over the walkable island.
template.why_score: A hole in the collider is a soft-lock.
acceptance: no ray passes through walkable ground

checks.note: Run the coverage test in Godot.

must_cover.topic: Island reacts to storm phase and tide (acts accordingly)

template.title: Island reacts to storm phase and sea state
template.detail: Wet rock, spray and shoreline respond to phase and the Wave agent's sea state.

checks.note: Compare ISLAND and RETURN in Godot.

must_cover.topic: Island matches the island concept art

template.title: Compare island to the concept art
template.why_score: Art direction is locked by the concept art.
